newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish fund Fidelia to start units sale March 26.
newsitem.headline: Polish fund Fidelia to start units sale March 26.

text.p: The Polish investment fund company Towarzystwo Funduszy Powierniczych Fidelia SA (Fidelia) plans to start selling units of its balanced fund on March 26, an adviser to the firm's management said on Tuesday.
"The balanced fund will be the first fund in Fidelia's family of funds, which we hope will soon be broadened," Arkadiusz Dobryjanowicz told Reuters.
He said the firm sought to launch two more funds, a bond-based fund and an aggressive fund, around the third quarter this year.

Dobryjanowicz said the company, which received securities commission permission to start operations in February 1996, was delayed in selling units because of difficulties in finding a domestic trustee bank, which will be BRE.
He said Universal and Normico Holding each hold 37.75 percent of the company with consulting firm Fidelia Centrum Ltd holding the rest.
Dobryjanowicz said the balanced fund sought to gain net assets of 60 million zlotys by the end of this year but would give no other financial details.
